recommendations: In SDK 3.0.6 the depth level is NOT a parameter: it is chosen by the subscribe method (subscribe_scrips=L4, subscribe_depth=L8, subscribe_full_depth=L16).
L4 (touch line, 1+1 rows) and L8 (depth, 5+5 rows) delivered a REAL live, evolving book for WIPRO during NSE cash hours (verified).

L16 (full depth) was ACK-accepted but delivered ONLY a static reference snapshot: prev-session OHLC, volume=0, total buy/sell=0, EMPTY book (0+0 rows) in two separate capture windows. Treat subscribe_full_depth as NOT delivering live full-book depth for this account/kotakneoapi 3.0.6 until provisioned.
Use ONE subscribe method per instrument per connection to keep the feed-level tag unambiguous.
seq_no / bitmask_length / _indicative_close / _trading_status are present on the raw wire but DISCARDED by the SDK parser.
Do NOT schedule quote or scrip-master refreshes faster than the broker rate limits; treat scrip master as static per-day and quote as on-demand/cached.
